title: Among female patients born between 1975 and 1985 who have had at least two
question: Among female patients born between 1975 and 1985 who have had at least two laboratory tests showing abnormal fibrinogen levels, what is the most frequently diagnosed condition?

prediction.sql:
SELECT P."XCL_064"
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND P."XCL_060" BETWEEN '1975-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
  AND P."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT L."XCL_014"
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L."XCL_036" < 200 OR L."XCL_036" > 400
    GROUP BY L."XCL_014"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
  )
GROUP BY P."XCL_064"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT E."XCL_006" AS condition
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND P."XCL_060" BETWEEN '1975-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
  AND P."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT P2."XCL_058"
    FROM Patient AS P2
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L2 ON P2."XCL_058" = L2."XCL_014"
    WHERE P2."XCL_059" = 'F'
      AND P2."XCL_060" BETWEEN '1975-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
      AND L2."XCL_041" = 'TR'
      AND L2."XCL_045" NOT IN ('-', '0')
    GROUP BY P2."XCL_058"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
  )
GROUP BY E."XCL_006"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
